== display_discharging
display /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/DisplayDevice
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/DisplayDevice Type u 2
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/DisplayDevice PowerSupply b 1
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/DisplayDevice IsPresent b 1
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/DisplayDevice State u 2
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/DisplayDevice Percentage d 64.75
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/DisplayDevice TimeToEmpty x 5400
== display_not_battery
display /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/DisplayDevice
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/DisplayDevice Type u 0
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/DisplayDevice PowerSupply b 1
== display_wrong_type
display /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/DisplayDevice
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/DisplayDevice Type i 2
== enumerate
enumerate /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/line_power_AC,/org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/battery_BAT0,/org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/mouse,/org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/battery_BAT1
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/line_power_AC Type u 1
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/line_power_AC PowerSupply b 1
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/battery_BAT0 Type u 2
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/battery_BAT0 PowerSupply b 1
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/battery_BAT0 IsPresent b 1
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/battery_BAT0 State u 4
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/battery_BAT0 Percentage d 100.0
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/battery_BAT0 TimeToEmpty x 0
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/mouse Type u 2
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/mouse PowerSupply b 0
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/mouse IsPresent b 1
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/battery_BAT1 Type u 2
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/battery_BAT1 PowerSupply b 1
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/battery_BAT1 IsPresent b 1
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/battery_BAT1 State u 1
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/battery_BAT1 Percentage d 30.5
== enumerate_absent
enumerate /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/battery_BAT0
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/battery_BAT0 Type u 2
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/battery_BAT0 PowerSupply b 1
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/battery_BAT0 IsPresent b 0
p /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/battery_BAT0 Percentage d 0.0
== enumerate_empty
enumerate
== pending_states
enumerate /b5,/b6,/b9
p /b5 Type u 2
p /b5 PowerSupply b 1
p /b5 IsPresent b 1
p /b5 State u 5
p /b5 Percentage d 79.9
p /b5 TimeToEmpty x 60
p /b6 Type u 2
p /b6 PowerSupply b 1
p /b6 IsPresent b 1
p /b6 State u 6
p /b6 TimeToEmpty x 120
p /b9 Type u 2
p /b9 PowerSupply b 1
p /b9 IsPresent b 1
p /b9 State u 9
p /b9 Percentage d 150
p /b9 TimeToEmpty x 7200
== no_state
display /d
p /d Type u 2
p /d PowerSupply b 1
p /d IsPresent b 1
p /d Percentage d 12
== no_upower
